sentences.en: She had a bad infection and her ovary swelled up.
sentences.zh: 她得了严重的感染，卵巢肿了起来。

sentences.en: The hospital quarantined the infected patients to avoid cross infection.
sentences.zh: 医院隔离了感染者以防止交叉感染。

sentences.en: Sami feared the infection on his leg would spread further.
sentences.zh: 萨米担心腿上的感染会进一步扩散。

senses.zh: <医>传染，感染,传染病，染毒物,影响
